verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Vestd serves an llms.txt at https://www.vestd.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), with a structured product summary an agent can be pointed at. That meets the story's 'llms.txt or agent-oriented docs' condition. Other agent-oriented formats are absent: the markdown help endpoint returned 404 and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: evidence of how much the llms.txt actually covers, markdown versions of docs pages, an llms-full.txt or deeper agent-oriented documentation, and independent corroboration of agent use.
